1.title: Minnesota not Iran to blame for state's water issues, says Trump
1.summary: The US president's comments come after cyber attacks on Minnesota's water systems earlier this week, with US media indicating Iran could be behind it.

2.title: Driver Fatally Shoots Kidnapped Victim in Trunk in Chino Hills
2.summary: An abduction from a home in Southern California led to a short police chase. The driver fired at a man in the trunk before being gunned down.

3.title: Todd Blanche’s Loyalty to Trump Is Putting His Attorney General Confirmation at Risk
3.summary: Todd Blanche’s approach has collided with the jury-of-two reality in the Senate that has, thus far, kept him from the prize he covets: the stability and status conferred by a Senate confirmation.

4.title: Live Updates: After Tens of Thousands of Migrants Enter Spanish Territory, Most Return to Morocco
4.summary: About 48,000 of the up to 60,000 people who came into Ceuta from Morocco returned within a day. Still, the sudden influx created a crisis for Spain’s pro-immigration government. Nearly three dozen died.

5.title: At Least 34 Dead From Coal Mine Blast in Pakistan
5.summary: Rescuers were searching for missing bodies from the accident in one of the country’s mining hubs, where methane gas explosions and mine collapses are frequent.

6.title: Did 75,000 Students Cheat on a College-Entrance Exam in Mexico?
6.summary: The National Autonomous University of Mexico, or UNAM, has asked all students who passed a demanding entrance exam to take a new test after experts found half of all applicants may have cheated, including with A.I.
